description: Look up a Hebrew or Aramaic word in classic dictionaries (Jastrow, BDB, Klein, and others). Handles prefixes/inflected forms. Pass context_ref to disambiguate using the passage where the word appears.

context_ref.description: Passage the word appears in, e.g. "Berakhot 2a:1".

dictionary.description: Only return entries from this dictionary, e.g. "Jastrow Dictionary", "Klein Dictionary", "BDB Dictionary".

never_split.description: Don't try splitting prefixes off the word.

name: dictionary_lookup
title: Hebrew/Aramaic dictionary
